channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 23 Nov: Harare showers · high 29° / low 19°
item.description: Harare: high 29°, low 19° (showers) · Bulawayo: high 27°, low 19° (showers) · Mutare: high 30°, low 20° (drizzle) · Gweru: high 27°, low 19° (thunderstorm) · Masvingo: high 29°, low 21° (thunderstorm) · Victoria Falls: high 31°, low 22° (light showers) Tsumo yezuva: Mugoni wepwere ndeasinayo. (The one who knows how to raise children is one who has none.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
